guideUpdate.title: Return from Agentic AI to the launcher and open GIS
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Returning to the launcher and opening GIS
steps: Open Agentic AI from the V4 launcher.
Use your browser's Back button to return to the launcher.
Select Open GIS on the launcher.
Wait for the GIS map and its layer list, map style, reset, and zoom controls to appear.
guideUpdate.reason: Document the verified navigation from Agentic AI back to the launcher and into GIS, including the visible GIS map controls.
